title: Microsoft Teams: Ad-hoc room reservation from Teams Rooms on Windows console
description: With Teams Rooms on Windows consoles, you can quickly book a meeting room for immediate use, helping to avoid scheduling conflicts and ensure uninterrupted spontaneous meetings. Available in Teams Rooms Pro-licensed rooms.
